text.aria-label: Title text 'Extreme quantiles: how far the forecast ranges miss their promise'

g.text: Extreme quantiles: how far the forecast ranges miss their promise

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Zero is a perfectly calibrated quantile. Above zero, outcomes fell at or below the quantile more often than promised, so the quantile sits too high; below zero it sits too low. 292 daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each forecasting up to 14 days ahead. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months.'
text.tspan: Zero is a perfectly calibrated quantile. Above zero, outcomes fell at or below the quantile more often than
promised, so the quantile sits too high; below zero it sits too low. 292 daily forecast runs from July 2025
to June 2026, each forecasting up to 14 days ahead. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months.
